name: Mika Salo
bio:
Mika Salo's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for speed, fueled by watching rallying legends tear through the Finnish forests. His early career saw him excel in karting and Formula Ford, before transitioning into team management. He believes a sporting director should act as a bridge, ensuring seamless communication between the engineering, driver, and commercial sides of the team. Mika is known for his meticulous approach to strategy and his ability to remain calm under pressure, a trait he honed during countless tense moments on the track.

After early success in junior formula as a driver, Mika transitioned to the pitwall where his technical acumen and understanding of vehicle dynamics quickly made him an asset. He emphasizes a data-driven approach, but also values the intuition and feedback of the drivers. He also works closely with sponsors to ensure the team's vision aligns with their values. Now at MP Motorsport Junior, Mika aims to develop the next generation of Finnish racing talent.

physical.description: Mika is a lean man with a focused gaze and a perpetually serious expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, jotting down observations during races.
Insists on having a specific type of Finnish coffee before every race.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on the table when deep in thought.
